descriptions.tsonnet_c32_stream_write_80208994: While the pending flag at offset 28 is set, formats the header string at offset 24 with the elapsed-millisecond value into a 128-byte local buffer and writes it through the sixth virtual slot of the stream at offset 20, returning early on a negative result and clearing the flag otherwise; then writes the caller's data and size through the same slot and returns its result; field meanings are inferred. The 128-byte formatting buffer and caller lengths are not validated for arbitrary inputs.
